name: reload-diff
description: Instant in-editor diff highlights on silent file reloads (works without Git).

commands.title: Compare Active File with State Before Reload

reloadDiff.enabled.description: Global On/Off: Enable or disable diff highlighting on file reload.

reloadDiff.autoFadeSeconds.description: Seconds before highlights automatically fade (0 to keep until edit or clear).

reloadDiff.highlightLineBackground.description: Enable or disable line background tinting.

reloadDiff.addedLineColor.description: Background color for added lines (leave empty for theme default green, or set custom RGBA/HEX).

reloadDiff.modifiedLineColor.description: Background color for modified lines (leave empty for soft blue tint, or set custom RGBA/HEX).

reloadDiff.modifiedWordColor.description: Highlight color for changed words inside modified lines (leave empty for theme default, or set custom RGBA/HEX).
